prompt.en: In a province, whose job is most like the Prime Minister's?
prompt.fr: Dans une province, quelle fonction ressemble le plus à celle du premier ministre du Canada?

options.fr: Celle du premier ministre de la province.

explanation.en: The premier leads the government of a province, the way the Prime Minister leads the federal government. The Lieutenant Governor matches the Governor General instead, so it is easy to pair the wrong two.
explanation.fr: Le premier ministre de la province dirige le gouvernement provincial, comme le premier ministre dirige le gouvernement fédéral. C'est plutôt le lieutenant-gouverneur qui correspond au gouverneur général; on associe donc facilement les mauvaises fonctions.

source.quote: In each province, the Premier has a role similar to that of the Prime Minister in the federal government, just as the Lieutenant Governor has a role similar to that of the Governor General.

verification.evidence: In each province, the Premier has a role similar to that of the Prime Minister in the federal government, just as the Lieutenant Governor has a role similar to that of the Governor General. In the three territories, the Commissioner represents the federal government and plays a ceremonial role.
